properties.title: A transaction that the owner has not signed is rejected.
properties.content:
∀ (p : VestingParams) (ctx : ScriptContext),
        ¬ txSignedBy p.vpOwner ctx.scriptContextTxInfo →
          isUnsuccessful (vestingValidator p (toLedgerData ctx))

properties.title: A transaction is rejected when it leaves less value at the address of the input it spends than the total of the tranches that are not yet vested.
properties.content:
∀ (p : VestingParams) (ctx : ScriptContext) (now : POSIXTime) (v : Value),
        txRangeStartsAt now ctx.scriptContextTxInfo.txInfoValidRange →
          continuingValue ctx = some v →
            ¬ geq v (unvested p now) →
              isUnsuccessful (vestingValidator p (toLedgerData ctx))

properties.title: A transaction is rejected when the validator is not spending one of its inputs.
properties.content:
∀ (p : VestingParams) (ctx : ScriptContext),
        findOwnInput ctx = none →
          isUnsuccessful (vestingValidator p (toLedgerData ctx))

properties.title: A transaction is accepted when it spends an input the validator guards, is signed by the owner, and leaves at least the total of the tranches that are not yet vested at the address of that input.
properties.content:
∀ (p : VestingParams) (ctx : ScriptContext) (now : POSIXTime) (v : Value),
        txSignedBy p.vpOwner ctx.scriptContextTxInfo →
          txRangeStartsAt now ctx.scriptContextTxInfo.txInfoValidRange →
            continuingValue ctx = some v →
              geq v (unvested p now) →
                isSuccessful (vestingValidator p (toLedgerData ctx))

properties.title: A transaction is rejected when what reaches the validator in place of a script context does not decode as one.
properties.content: ∀ (p : VestingParams), isUnsuccessful (vestingValidator p (Data.I 0))

properties.title: A guess whose hash matches the datum terminates successfully for every context.
properties.content:
∀ (actual guess : ByteString) (ctx : Data), hashMatches actual guess →
      isSuccessful (gameValidator (Data.B actual) (Data.B guess) ctx)

properties.title: A guess whose hash differs from the datum fails script evaluation for every context.
properties.content:
∀ (actual guess : ByteString) (ctx : Data), ¬ hashMatches actual guess →
      isUnsuccessful (gameValidator (Data.B actual) (Data.B guess) ctx)

properties.title: An integer datum fails to decode as the stored hash, for every redeemer and context.
properties.content: ∀ (n : Integer) (r ctx : Data), isSuccessful (gameValidator (Data.I n) r ctx)

properties.title: The separately compiled helper returns the native comparison result.
properties.content: ∀ (old proposed : Integer), outbids_returns old proposed (decide (old <= proposed))

properties.title: For the upstream no-previous-bid scenario, the minimum, deadline, locked Ada and NFT quantity characterize success.
properties.content:
∀ (proposed locked tokens hi : Integer),
      isSuccessful (bidScenario auction 0 proposed locked 0 tokens hi) ↔
        100 ≤ proposed ∧ hi ≤ 1725227091000 ∧ locked = proposed ∧ tokens = 1

properties.title: For a positive previous bid, success requires a strictly larger bid, exact refund, correct continuing value and the deadline.
properties.content:
∀ (old proposed locked refund tokens hi : Integer), 0 < old →
      (isSuccessful (bidScenario auction old proposed locked refund tokens hi) ↔
        old < proposed ∧ hi ≤ 1725227091000 ∧ locked = proposed ∧ refund = old ∧ tokens = 1)

properties.title: For the upstream payout scenario, the deadline, NFT and seller payment characterize success.
properties.content:
∀ (bid paid tokens lo : Integer),
      isSuccessful (payoutScenario auction bid paid tokens lo) ↔
        1725227091000 ≤ lo ∧ tokens = 1 ∧ (0 < bid → paid = bid)
